newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Land stockholders approve debt issue.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Land stockholders approve debt issue.

text.p: Shareholders of Ayala Land Inc have approved the issue of 4.0 billion to 6.0 billion pesos worth of long-term commercial paper.
In a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange on Tuesday, the company said shareholders also the denial of their preemptive rights to the underlying conversion shares of the long-term papers.
The latest issue is convertible into Ayala Land Class B shares with a par value of one peso. It will have a term of five years and the offer price will be at par.
The proposed debt issue has been registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission. This will be Ayala Land's second offering following a successful 3.0 billion peso issue in December 1994.
